intended_object: This is right whiskering of a modification by an oplax natural transformation, for lax functors B → C. Given a modification Γ : η ⇛ θ between oplax transformations F ⇒ G, and an oplax transformation ι : G ⇒ H, it gives the modification Γ ▷ ι : η ≫ ι ⇛ θ ≫ ι, with components (Γ ▷ ι)_a = Γ_a ▷ ι_a. The source is the docstring and the module doc, which describe the bicategory of lax functors.
explanation:
The component at each object a is Γ.as.app a ▷ ι.app a. This is the standard formula for whiskering a modification on the right by a transformation in the functor bicategory. The naturality (modification) condition is proved in the body, so the construction is well defined.

The setting is general: arbitrary bicategories B and C, lax functors, and oplax transformations. It is the oplax counterpart of `Lax.LaxTrans.whiskerRight` in the same file.

Mathlib does have a similarly named `Oplax.OplaxTrans.whiskerRight`, but it works with oplax functors, a different setting, so it is not a more general version of this definition.

The definition matches the standard notion at its natural generality.
